text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Political parties pursue "tough" campaign for the June parliamentary elections.
- Algeria to increase its pharmaceutical production.
- Opposition Front of Socialist Forces party to activate its membership in the electoral commission watchdog.

- Countdown starts for Algeria's elections. Story says Algerians are mobilised to elect a new parliament in June 5, the first since authorities suspended the second round of legislative elections in 1992.
- Algerian security forces, helped by tip-offs in return for hefty government rewards, killed three "terrorists".
- Algeria signs agreement with European Union for cooperation in medical and pharmaceutical sectors.
